summary: Preinstall bootstraps Bun runtime to execute obfuscated in-tarball payload
details: @onereach/si-select@0.1.3 is advertised as a Vue select UI component but ships install-time code unrelated to that purpose. package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated and downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, then invokes that runtime against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {stdio:'inherit'})`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (string-array rotation via `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`, hex-mangled identifiers, large numeric lookup table) whose contents are not human-readable and do not correspond to a UI component. Additionally, package.json declares `"files": ["lib/*"]`, yet both setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped at the tarball root outside that allowlist — the install-time dropper and payload sit outside the author's declared publish surface. Installing the package on default `npm install` fetches a foreign JS runtime and executes an opaque attacker-shipped payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
